title: KB Fellowship at NIAS
program_type: Residual research fellowship at a national advanced-study institute, funded jointly by NIAS and the National Library of the Netherlands
duration: Five months, from September to January
description: The Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study offers temporary fellowships at an intellectual haven to a diverse year group of international scientists, writers, journalists and artists.

title: Willem F. Duisenberg Fellowship
program_type: Residual research fellowship in economics at a national advanced-study institute, funded by the Willem F. Duisenberg Fellowship Foundation
duration: 5 to 10 months, as either a five-month or a ten-month semester
description: Fellowship at NIAS for researchers in the field of applied monetary economics, macro-economics or public finance

title: Eric Bleumink Fellowship
program_type: Master's scholarship grant awarded by the university, nomination-based
duration: 1 or 2 year master's degree programme, starting in September only
description: The Eric Bleumink Fellowship is a University of Groningen grant for nationals of a listed group of countries who hold provisional or unconditional admission to a one or two year master's programme starting in September. The grant covers tuition fee, international travel, subsistence, books and health insurance. It is nomination-based: the University of Groningen's Admission Office decides which admitted applicants are nominated, so there is no direct scholarship application. title: KITLV Visiting Fellowship
official_source: Royal Netherlands Institute of Southeast Asian and Caribbean Studies (KITLV)
program_type: Funded visiting research fellowship (three month research stay)
description: The KITLV Visiting Fellowship is a three month funded research stay at the Royal Netherlands Institute of Southeast Asian and Caribbean Studies (KITLV) in Leiden for researchers who hold a PhD in the social sciences and/or humanities and are not tax residents of the Netherlands. Fellows work on a publication or research project of their own choice in Southeast Asian or Caribbean Studies and do not need a university or research institute affiliation. The offer covers a return economy air or train fare, reimbursement of accommodation costs in Leiden up to EUR 2,000 per month against proof of pay

title: Tilburg University Waiver
program_type: Partial tuition-fee waiver awarded by the university (DEI scheme), allocated by lottery among eligible admitted applicants
duration: One year of tuition for a regular Master's programme; the two-year Master in Cognitive Science and Artificial Intelligence is also eligible
description: The Tilburg University Waiver halves the institutional tuition fee for up to 21 non-EEA international applicants each year, as part of the university's Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitment. It applies to all regular one-year Master's programmes starting in September 2027, with the two-year Master in Cognitive Science and Artificial Intelligence as an explicit exception; Research Master's and Pre-Master's students are not eligible. title: Radboud Scholarship Programme
program_type: Partial tuition-fee scholarship awarded by the university, merit-based
duration: Nominal duration of the Master's programme
description: The Radboud Scholarship Programme is a highly selective Radboud University scheme for talented, highly motivated non-EU/non-EEA students with outstanding study results, covering English-taught Master's programmes.
